qualification: The reviewer previously authored the focused pyscan and CLI tests. Two additional read-only reviewers independently examined standards/spec behavior; root-owned engine tests and all product changes were independently inspected here.
review_method: Read-only two-axis code-review plus independent in-memory application of the accepted patches to the base files. No product tests or full validation gates were run by this review.
review_target: Uncommitted working-tree diff against the fixed base; no newer implementation commit is claimed.

review_update.result: No active findings remain. Public-hook lifecycle regression protection was added by root and read back statically; the review did not rerun tests.

verified: Only the two accepted built-ins opt in; the default Rule hook returns no reason and does not inspect context.
Engine asks the hook only after applicable, non-stub built-in checks return an empty result. Nonempty PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED, inapplicability and generated-rule paths bypass this new branch.
New skip uses existing identity/fix_hint construction with INFO, skipped, fixed count or unavailable reason and empty evidence; ordering and summary code remain untouched.
Profile severity overrides remain restricted to FAIL; suppression keeps its original post-override behavior. A suppressed skip cannot become a failure.
Unknown and inconsistent counts use the accepted fixed unavailable text. Consistent observed zero candidates and zero file budget are valid; a zero budget with candidates is an observed gap.
Coverage is a frozen snapshot, normal completed scans mark observation, warning prose is never parsed into facts, and parse/read skips count only actual AST successes.
No schema, profile bundle, dependency/version or historical gold files changed.

standards.summary: No actionable documented-standard breach or code smell. Python >=3.10, lightweight dependencies, no network/model endpoint, deterministic integer-only messages, immutable internal coverage, no persisted schema or redaction changes; explicit D-41 acceptance is recorded.

test_protection_observations.observation: Complete output equality cannot detect an extra early hook call whose result is discarded. This is a regression-protection gap, not a demonstrated defect in the current engine.
test_protection_observations.resolution: The added test_pass_hook_is_not_queried_for_failures_or_inapplicable_rules creates actual vllm source and a manifest, then attaches throwing public-hook probes to both opted-in rules and the genuinely inapplicable trust-remote rule. Actual checks/detection remain unchanged. Assertions establish the first two outputs are nonempty FAIL and the third follows applies=false. This detects an extra early hook call; the same source truthiness branch preserves nonempty explicit PASS/SKIPPED regardless of their status.
test_protection_observations.suggested_action: If strengthening this explicit interface contract, use a controlled public Rule.pass_skip_reason probe to reject calls on applies=false or nonempty results and observe the empty-result call, without replacing rules/detection to manufacture a successful audit.
